title.narrative: Improving access to and quality of primary education via PBF in Shabee Sombo district, Jimma zone, Ethiopia (Phase 2)

description.narrative: Primary school students at schools in Shabe Sombo district of Jimma zone and the Ethiopian Federal Ministry of Education

The overarching main objective on "Improving Access to and Quality of Education Via PBF" project is to demonstrate that the simultaneous application of PBF in the health and education sectors can help build Human Capital in one district in Jimma Zone (Oromia Region, Ethiopia).
Specific objectives of the projects are: 1. Improve the availability and accessibility of good quality, inclusive primary education. 2. Improve the accuracy and reliability of routinely reported data. 3. Improve transparency and accountability within the education sector 4. Strengthen the governance of the education system at WEO in synergy with the health system

The vision of the Ethiopian Education Sector Development Plan (ESDP) VI is “Transforming society through harnessing the full potentials of learners to become productive citizens” (ESDP VI, 2021). The philosophy of the Federal Ministry of Education (FMoE) roadmap hinges on the preparation of the young generation for the future by building their moral, cognitive, social, spiritual, physical, psychological and vocational attributes whilst also understanding that education is a public good which serves as a means for social harmony and development which will transform Ethiopia into a respectable member of the world (ESDP VI, 2021). Several strides have been made by the Ethiopian government and its partners in the education sector through development and setting up of policy frameworks which the education sector is based on, in addition to investments in construction and equipping of various schools, and training of the human resources across the country. However, more needs to be done to build and sustain an education system that is comparable to other world class standards.
Cordaid has been piloting Performance Based Financing (PBF) in the primary education sector in Shabe Sombo Woreda of Jimma Zone to support the Federal Ministry of Education (FMoE) in the achievement of the goals set in the sixth Education Sector Development Plan (ESDP VI). Performance Based Financing (PBF) is a social financing mechanism used in the health, education, and other sectors mostly in Low and Medium-Income Countries (LMIC) across the globe. PBF has already been implemented in the health sector of Jimma Zone since 2019 (in all 21 woredas) and will continue to be complemented by this pilot project. This project aims to build Human Capital and create synergy between the two sectors through the combined implementation of PBF in health and education in one woreda (Shabe).
